import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, IntegerType

# Azure storage access info
blob_account_name = 'adlsfhirnonprod'
blob_container_name = 'raw'
blob_relative_path = '30tb'
linked_service_name = 'lsadlsfhirnonprod'

blob_sas_token = mssparkutils.credentials.getConnectionStringOrCreds(linked_service_name)

# Allow Spark to access Storage remotely

wasb_path = 'wasbs://%s@%s.blob.core.windows.net/%s' % (blob_container_name, blob_account_name, blob_relative_path)
spark.conf.set('fs.azure.sas.%s.%s.blob.core.windows.net' % (blob_container_name, blob_account_name), blob_sas_token)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + blob_account_name + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + blob_relative_path + "/Observation/"

observationSchemaFile = wasb_path + "/000047ca-00c7-492b-bf65-740805144cd2/Observation.ndjson"
observationSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(observationSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(observationSchema).json(wasb_path + "/*/Observation.ndjson");
df = df.withColumn("year", F.year(F.to_date(F.col("issued"))))

df = df.filter(F.col("year") >= 2016)
df = df.filter(F.col("year") <= 2020)

df.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year").json(bronzePath)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + blob_account_name + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + blob_relative_path + "/Claim/"

claimSchemaFile = wasb_path + "/000047ca-00c7-492b-bf65-740805144cd2/Claim.ndjson"
claimSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(claimSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(claimSchema).json(wasb_path + "/*/Claim.ndjson");
df = df.withColumn("year", F.year(F.to_date(F.col("created"))))

df = df.filter(F.col("year") >= 2016)
df = df.filter(F.col("year") <= 2020)

df.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year").json(bronzePath)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + blob_account_name + ".dfs.core.windows.net/incremental_data/" + blob_relative_path + "/Observation/"

observationSchemaFile = wasb_path + "/000047ca-00c7-492b-bf65-740805144cd2/Observation.ndjson"
observationSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(observationSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(observationSchema).json(wasb_path + "/*/Observation.ndjson");
df = df.withColumn("year", F.year(F.to_date(F.col("issued"))))
df = df.withColumn("month", F.date_format(F.to_date(F.col("issued")), 'MM'))
df = df.withColumn("day", F.date_format(F.to_date(F.col("issued")), 'dd'))

df = df.filter(F.col("year") == 2021)
df = df.repartition("year", "month")

df.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month", "day").json(bronzePath)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + blob_account_name + ".dfs.core.windows.net/incremental_data/" + blob_relative_path + "/Claim/"

claimSchemaFile = wasb_path + "/000047ca-00c7-492b-bf65-740805144cd2/Claim.ndjson"
claimSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(claimSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(claimSchema).json(wasb_path + "/*/Claim.ndjson");
df = df.withColumn("year", F.year(F.to_date(F.col("created"))))
df = df.withColumn("month", F.date_format(F.to_date(F.col("created")), 'MM'))
df = df.withColumn("day", F.date_format(F.to_date(F.col("created")), 'dd'))

df = df.filter(F.col("year") == 2021)
df = df.repartition("year", "month")

df.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month", "day").json(bronzePath)
